name: Mesolimbic and mesocortical dopamine (reward) pathways, with nigrostriatal and tuberoinfundibular pathways for contrast
function: Reward, motivation and incentive salience (mesolimbic/mesocortical); motor control (nigrostriatal); neuroendocrine prolactin regulation (tuberoinfundibular)

evidence.quote: The mesolimbic pathway projects from the ventral tegmental area (VTA) to the ventral striatum.
The MFB is the most prominent mesolimbic reward pathway connecting the ventral tegmental areas with the prefrontal cortex
The MFB connects the midbrain's periaqueductal gray matter (PAG) to the ventral tegmental areas and the prefrontal cortex (PreFr).
the nucleus accumbens receives a strong dopaminergic input from the ventral tegmental area, whereas the caudate-putamen complex receives a similar projection from the substantia nigra
Behavioral and pharmacological studies of dopamine pathways have lead to the association of the mesolimbic pathway with reward processing and nigro-striatal pathway with motor activity.
evidence.species: cross-species synthesis (primate anatomy and human imaging review)

evidence.quote: The midbrain dopamine neurons project massively to the striatum
the nucleus accumbens (NAcc) and the ventral tegmental area (VTA) dopamine neurons appear to be at the center
evidence.species: cross-species synthesis (primate anatomy and human imaging review)

evidence.quote: The mesocortical pathway projecting from the VTA to the prefrontal cortex is, in turn, more involved in executive functions although it also contributes to reward processing.
abnormalities in the synaptic transmission from mesocortical dopaminergic fibres to the pyramidal neurons giving origin to the prefronto-accumbens projection
evidence.species: cross-species (addiction neurocircuitry synthesis discussed alongside human neuroimaging data)

steps.cellBodies: Substantia nigra pars compacta dopaminergic neurons

evidence.quote: The nigrostriatal pathway connects substantia nigra to the striatum (putamen and caudate) and contributes critically to motion control.
whereas the caudate-putamen complex receives a similar projection from the substantia nigra, further substantiates the interpretation of the nucleus accumbens as a part of the ventral striatum
the ventral SNc neurons project to the dorsal striatum

courseVia: tuberoinfundibular pathway to the median eminence / hypophyseal portal system

evidence.quote: Finally, the tuberoinfundibular pathway connects the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland.
